model_annotations.Bulgarian: Фигурата илюстрира сравнение на средните стойности на скритите състояния за три различни условия – преди преминаване през врата, след преминаване през врата и базова стойност – в зависимост от номера на слоя в модела. Осата X е обозначена като „Layer“ и представлява линейна скала, която показва номера на слоя, с диапазон от 0 до 22. Етикетите са разположени с интервал от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Осата Y е обозначена като „Abs Mean“ и представлява линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до 4, с етикети на интервали от 1 единица (0, 1, 2, 3, 4). Синята пунктирана линия, означаваща „hidden state mean before gate“, започва при стойност около 0.3 при слой 0, колебае се в интервала между 0.2 и 0.8 до слой 18, след което рязко се повишава до стойност около 3.5 при слой 20 и достига върхове над 4 при слой 22. Оранжевата пунктирана линия, означаваща „hidden state mean after gate“, започва при стойност около 0.05 при слой 0 и остава почти неподвижна, с леко нарастващ тренд, достигайки стойност около 0.07 при слой 22. Зелената линия, означаваща „hidden state mean of baseline“, започва при стойност около 0.02 при слой 0 и се движи почти хоризонтално, с леко нарастващ тренд, достигайки стойност около 0.04 при слой 22.
model_annotations.Chinese: The graph, titled "Hidden State Mean," displays the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers for three distinct conditions: the mean before a gate (dashed blue line), the mean after a gate (dotted orange line), and the mean of a baseline (solid green line). The x-axis, labeled "Layer," represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22 on a linear scale with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," indicates the absolute mean value, ranging from 0 to 4 on a linear scale with major tick marks at intervals of 1. The dashed blue line, representing the hidden state mean before the gate, starts at a value of approximately 0.1 at layer 0 and remains relatively stable with minor fluctuations until layer 19, after which it exhibits a sharp increase, rising to a value of approximately 4.3 at layer 22. The dotted orange line, representing the hidden state mean after the gate, begins at approximately 0.02 at layer 0 and remains consistently low, showing a slight upward trend to a value of about 0.05 at layer 22. The solid green line, representing the baseline, starts at a value of approximately 0.01 at layer 0 and remains nearly flat, with a very slight increase to a value of about 0.04 at layer 22.
model_annotations.English: The line plot, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the evolution of the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers for three distinct cases. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to 22 in integer steps, representing the layer number in a neural network. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," ranges from 0 to 4, indicating the absolute mean value. The plot displays three lines: a blue dashed line representing the "hidden state mean before gate," which starts at an average of 0.71 and remains relatively stable until layer 20, after which it sharply increases to a value above 4; a red dotted line for the "hidden state mean after gate," with an average of 0.05, which stays nearly flat and close to zero across all layers; and a green solid line for the "hidden state mean of baseline," with an average of 0.04, which also remains nearly constant and close to zero throughout the layers.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt den absoluten Mittelwert der versteckten Zustände über verschiedene Schichten (Layer), wobei drei verschiedene Messgrößen verglichen werden: der absolute Mittelwert der versteckten Zustände vor dem Gate, der absolute Mittelwert nach dem Gate und der absolute Mittelwert der Basislinie. Die x-Achse repräsentiert die Schichtnummer, mit einem linearen Skalierungsintervall von 0 bis 22, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in Schritten von 5 angegeben sind. Die y-Achse zeigt den absoluten Mittelwert, mit einem linearen Wertebereich von 0 bis 4 und Tick-Beschriftungen in Schritten von 1. Die blaue gestrichelte Linie, die den "hidden state mean before gate" darstellt, beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 0,1 an Layer 0 und bleibt auf niedrigem Niveau bis Layer 18, wo sie dann stark ansteigt und bei Layer 22 einen Wert von etwa 4,2 erreicht. Die orangefarbene punktierte Linie, die den "hidden state mean after gate" darstellt, beginnt bei etwa 0,01 an Layer 0 und bleibt nahezu konstant bei einem Wert von etwa 0,05 über den gesamten Bereich der Schichten. Die grüne durchgezogene Linie, die den "hidden state mean of baseline" darstellt, beginnt bei etwa 0,02 an Layer 0 und bleibt nahezu konstant bei einem Wert von etwa 0,04 über die gesamte Schichtzahl.
